title: 第19章 猎杀姬扶摇第20章 二徒弟叶尘
slug: 我的徒弟们都太逆天了
lines: “师父，你为什么对我这么好？”
闻言，陆玄淡淡一笑，“因为你是我徒弟啊。”
他这可是一本万利的投资啊！
对徒弟好就是对自己好！
何乐而不为？
躺着就能变强，他只需要把所有修炼资源给徒弟就行了。
可以说坐享其成！
但姬扶摇却是娇躯一颤，喃喃道，“因为我是你的徒弟……”
只是这个原因吗？
她的眼眶微微湿润。
上一世，她是扶摇皇朝的一方女帝，从未有过这样的感受。
这一世，有一个人这样对她好，这种感觉真好。
她的心中有些感动。
陆玄笑了笑，“其实去宗外历练一下也挺好的，你去吧，不用管我。”
姬扶摇脸上神采奕奕，明丽动人，点了点头。
一想到自己走后，又没人给陆玄做饭了，她的心里有些歉意。
这一走，恐怕要一些时日了。
念及此。
姬扶摇走近了草屋，“师父，我给你做完饭，再走。”
陆玄点头道，“好。”
这一次，姬扶摇做饭很用心。
草屋里炊烟袅袅。
陆玄躺在躺椅上，晒在悠哉的晒着太阳。
巴适得很。
不多时。
姬扶摇撩了撩青丝，将热气腾腾的饭菜端了出来。
“师父，吃饭啦。”
陆玄点了点头，来到石桌前。
“这次尝起来不错。”
陆玄吃了一口，点评道。
姬扶摇柔和一笑，“好。”
她想起来，第一次为陆玄做饭的时候，陆玄的评价是“还凑合。”
那个时候，她对陆玄心中还是很不服气的。
但现在。
她服了。
上一世，她从未有过这种感觉！
姬扶摇在心里已经打定主意。
在青玄峰之外，她是扶摇女帝，但是在师父陆玄的面前，她永远是徒弟。
姬扶摇也吃了起来。
content_en:
"Master, why are you so nice to me?"
Hearing this, Lu Xuan smiled lightly, "Because you are my disciple."
他这可是一本万利的投资啊！
To be good to your apprentice is to be good to yourself!
Why not?
He can become stronger just lying down, he just needs to give all his training resources to his apprentice.
It can be said that you can sit back and enjoy the results!
But Ji Fuyao trembled and murmured, "Because I am your apprentice..."
Is this the only reason?
Her eyes were slightly moist.
In her previous life, she was the empress of the Fuyao Dynasty and had never felt like this before.
In this life, there is someone who is so kind to her. It feels so good.
她的心中有些感动。
Lu Xuan smiled and said, "Actually, it's good to go outside the sect for some experience. You can go and don't worry about me."
Ji Fuyao's face was full of energy and bright, and she nodded.
When she thought that after she left, no one would cook for Lu Xuan, she felt a little apologetic.
This departure may take some time.
Think of this.
Ji Fuyao approached the thatched house and said, "Master, I'll finish cooking for you before leaving."
Lu Xuan nodded and said, "Okay."
这一次，姬扶摇做饭很用心。
Smoke curled up from the thatched hut.
Lu Xuan lay on the deck chair, basking in the sun leisurely.
Ba is very comfortable.
Not long after.
Ji Fuyao lifted her green hair and took out the steaming food.
"Master, it's time to eat."
陆玄点了点头，来到石桌前。
“这次尝起来不错。”
陆玄吃了一口，点评道。
Ji Fuyao smiled softly, "Okay."
She remembered that when she cooked for Lu Xuan for the first time, Lu Xuan's evaluation was "it's not bad."
At that time, she was still very unconvinced with Lu Xuan.
But now.
She was convinced.
上一世，她从未有过这种感觉！
Ji Fuyao had already made up her mind.
Outside Qingxuan Peak, she is Empress Fuyao, but in front of her master Lu Xuan, she will always be a disciple.
Ji Fuyao also started eating.
